title: ranunculus patulidentiformis
intro: Ranunculus patulidentiformis, commonly known as the little-flowered ranunculus, is a type of flowering plant in the genus Ranunculus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ranunculus patulidentiformis include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, inflammation, and promoting wound healing.
